message.content: The largest planet that has been confirmed so far is the protoplanet **HD 100546 b**. It is still forming around its host star and has an estimated radius of roughly **2.5–3 times that of Jupiter** (about 0.25 R☉). Its mass is also very high—on the order of ten times Jupiter’s mass—making it one of the most massive “planet‑like” objects known.
